selectedStyle: Incremental extension of the existing modular monolith

alternatives.name: Separate analytics service
cons: Operational overhead unjustified for this change

adrs.title: Extend ILinkStore additively
adrs.context: Existing callers and tests must keep working.
adrs.decision: Add an optional expiresAt to Create and new RecordClick/GetStats members.
adrs.consequences: Backward compatible; the in-memory store gains click tracking.

adrs.title: Return 410 Gone for expired links
adrs.context: Expired links must be distinguishable from unknown ones.
adrs.decision: Check expiry in GET /{code} and return 410.

components.name: Core
components.responsibility: Link with expiry; store with click tracking

techStack.rationale: Preserves the existing abstraction and passing tests.
